brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is '840D ballistic nylon / ripstop with welded liner'. Confirmed VERBATIM on two of five product pages: the Waterproof Pannier ('Rugged 840 denier nylon outer layer with welded-seam waterproof liner') and the Rack Top Bag ('Ripstop fabric upper with a rugged ballistic bottom panel'). The other three pages (Deluxe Seat Bag, Handlebar Bag Small, Top Tube Bag Large) do not state a fabric composition at all - only 'waterproof' marketing copy. All five photos, however, show the same matte black structured ballistic-weave texture with white/reflective piping, consistent with 840D ballistic nylon across the whole line; no photo contradicts the string, it's just unconfirmed by page text for three of five.
brand_notes.method: banjobrothers.com is Shopify; WebFetch returned rendered dimensions and copy directly for all five pages, no curl fallback needed. All dims below are maker-published, unit-converted from inches; none are estimates.

products.name: Waterproof Cycling Pannier
products.dims_raw: 1000 cubic inches / 16.4 liters; 14" H x 12" L x 7" W
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via WebFetch (matches brands.json). Page labels directly: H=14in=35.6cm -> hgt, L=12in=30.5cm -> len, W=7in=17.8cm -> wid. Sold and priced as a single pannier, not a pair. No range given, so no unfurled/min-height pick needed; hgt as published is treated as the as-used (partially rolled) figure since the photo already shows the bag rolled shut - see render.

geometry.notes: Boxy roll-top pannier, flat rack-facing back with visible rack hook hardware at the top, domed rolled top flap with a webbing carry handle threaded through it. White piping down the front vertical edge, red reflector/light-mount clip on the front-top corner, small circular reflective 'Banjo Brothers' badge on the front face.

closure.hardware: single fold-over roll, no separate buckle visible - carry handle strap doubles as the closure retainer

details.reflective: white piping down the front edge; small circular reflective badge; red reflector/light clip on the front-top corner
details.fabric: 840D ballistic nylon / ripstop with welded liner - matches brands.json; see brand_notes.fabric

render.basis: no unrolled figure is published to apply the minimum-of-range rule to; the photo already shows the bag rolled shut with a single fold, so the photographed/published figure is used directly as the drawn height.

mount.notes: Standard rack-hook pannier; silver hook hardware visible at the top of the back panel in the photo. Requires a rear rack.

products.name: Deluxe Seat Bag, Medium
products.dims_raw: 65-81 cubic inches / 1.1-1.3 liters; 6.75" L x 4" W x 3" H
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via WebFetch. Page labels directly: L=6.75in=17.1cm -> len, W=4in=10.2cm -> wid, H=3in=7.6cm -> hgt. Capacity is a range (1.1-1.3L) because the bottom gusset expands, not because any linear dimension is a range; dims are single figures. Stored the capacity midpoint 1.2L.

geometry.notes: Small firm-sided wedge, gusseted/expandable bottom seam, grey reflective piping around the full perimeter, rear pull-tab and cord-lock for a supplementary drawcord closure behind the main zip.

closure.hardware: single slider zip along the top, plus a rear drawcord/toggle

details.reflective: grey reflective piping around the full perimeter
details.fabric: 840D ballistic nylon / ripstop (page does not state fabric explicitly for this product; photo texture is consistent with the brand string) - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Single hook-and-loop strap around the seatpost just below the saddle rails; small, self-supporting wedge, no rail straps needed.

products.name: Handlebar Bag, Small
products.dims_raw: 120 cubic inches / 2.0 liters; 8" L x 4.5" W x 4.5" H
products.dims_note: CORRECTED from brands.json, which stored len:11.4 and wid:20.3 - the reverse of what the page's own axis labels give, and inconsistent with its own dims_note ('the 20.3cm long axis runs across the bars') which describes len but was written into the wid field. Rewritten whole: L=8in=20.3cm is the bag's own longest run (across the bars) -> len; W=H=4.5in=11.4cm is the round diameter -> wid and hgt both 11.4 (they are numerically identical on the page, so this pair cannot itself be transposed).

geometry.notes: Rigid-lined cylinder (maker copy: 'rigid liner to prevent sagging') lying across the bars, grey reflective stripe wrapping the perimeter over a two-way zip, cord-pull tabs on both zip sliders at one end.

closure.hardware: dual-slider zip under the reflective wrap stripe, paracord pull tabs

zips.notes: reflective fabric strip sewn over the zip run

details.reflective: full-perimeter grey reflective stripe over the zip
details.seams: welded (maker copy: fabric is waterproof, zip is covered)
details.fabric: 840D ballistic nylon / ripstop (page does not state fabric explicitly for this product; photo texture is consistent with the brand string) - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Two hook-and-loop straps directly over the bar tops, close in behind the stem. Rigid liner keeps the round cross-section from sagging onto cables.

products.name: Top Tube Bag, Large
products.dims_raw: 65 cubic inches / 1.1 liters; 7" L x 4' H x 2.5" W
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via WebFetch (page text has a stray apostrophe on the H figure, clearly meant as inches: 4"H). L=7in=17.8cm -> len, H=4in=10.2cm -> hgt, W=2.5in=6.4cm -> wid. 17.8x6.4x10.2 = 1.16L against the stated 1.1L / 65 cu in, a close match confirming this mapping - all three axes could not be wrong and still agree this closely. Rounded gas-tank silhouette in the photo (about 1.75:1 length:height) is consistent with a stubby 7in bag, not a tapered wedge.

geometry.notes: Short rounded gas-tank pack sitting behind the stem, white piping trim, circular 'Banjo Brothers' badge on the side face. Fairly boxy, not a sharp wedge - matches the close length:height agreement between box volume and stated capacity.

closure.hardware: single slider with paracord pull tab, along the top ridge

details.seams: covered/weatherproofed zip (maker copy: 'the fabric is waterproof and the zippers are covered')
details.fabric: 840D ballistic nylon / ripstop (page does not state fabric explicitly for this product; photo texture is consistent with the brand string) - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Straddles the top tube behind the stem on two hook-and-loop straps, rounded end forward, badge/pocket side facing out. Side zip pocket noted in brands.json's source features but not independently visible in the single photo angle reviewed here - carried over at medium confidence within an otherwise high-confidence record.

products.name: Rack Top Bag
products.dims_raw: 510 cubic inches; 14.75" L x 5.5" W x 6.75" H
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via WebFetch. L=14.75in=37.5cm -> len, W=5.5in=14cm -> wid, H=6.75in=17.1cm -> hgt. The product page itself renders 510 cubic inches as '14.3L', which is a page error - 510 cu in is actually 8.36L, and the dims box (37.5x14x17.1cm = 9.0L) confirms the litre figure, not the page's mislabeled '14.3L'. Stored capacity_l as 8.4, matching the correct conversion.

geometry.notes: Domed trunk bag, flat rack-mounting base, gusseted accordion pocket panel on the front face below the main zip, badge patch on the front-left. Reflective stripe wraps the lower perimeter.

closure.hardware: single slider zip running front-to-back over the dome, cord-lock pull

details.fabric: 840D ballistic nylon / ripstop with welded liner - matches brands.json; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Straps down to the rear rack deck, does not use rack hooks (unlike the pannier) - visible black webbing straps loop around the rack tubing in the photo.
